skills.name: kv-cache-vram-best-practices
skills.description: KV cache is the primary cause of VRAM OOM errors in llama.cpp, not weight quantization. Best practices: use q8_0 KV cache (--ctk q8_0 --ctv q8_0), cap context window aggressively, enable flash attention (-fa), and let the model fit+offload before tuning weight quant. Community-verified on 8-24GB VRAM setups.
skills.author: Community (via @sakuray on X)
key_rules: KV cache consumes VRAM proportional to context length x layers, not model size
Use --ctk q8_0 --ctv q8_0 to store KV cache in 8-bit (halves KV VRAM vs fp16)
Cap --c (ctx_size) to what you actually need -- 128K on 12GB will OOM without KV quant
Enable flash attention (-fa) before adjusting weight quantization
Use -fit to allow model to split across GPU/CPU when VRAM is tight
Tune weight quant (Q4 vs Q5 vs Q8) only after KV and context are stable
